name: @scotthuang/agent-knock-knock
changelog: Compact List v5 removes repeated usage prose and duplicate IDs while preserving exact selectors, readable unknown states, dynamic action inputs and blockers. OpenClaw, Pi and DSH default to v5; generic Host SDK and MCP keep v4 with explicit format selection and version-bound pagination. Budgets, raw CLI output, action contract 35 and execution authority remain unchanged. Coordinated core 0.16.8, Pi 0.1.0-poc.16 and DSH 0.1.0-rc.20. Formal release gate passed 3904 core tests, both connector gates, isolated OpenClaw compatibility, runtime validation and dry-run. No external delivery claim.
